fast.$description: Small, immediate feedback: hover, press, and toggle changes.

normal.$description: Default for most transitions: small elements appearing, expanding, or moving, such as tooltips and menus.

slow.$description: Large transitions, such as a dialog or bottom sheet entering. Pair with motion/easing/emphasized.

slower.$description: Full-screen transitions: one screen replacing another. Pair with motion/easing/emphasized.

standard.$description: Elements moving or resizing on screen: a short hold, then a slow landing.

emphasized.$description: Large moves the eye should follow, such as a dialog, sheet, or screen entering: holds a beat, sweeps through the middle, and settles slowly. The landing of standard with a longer hold. Pair with motion/duration/slow or slower.

enter.$description: Elements appearing: starts fast and slows to rest. The landing of standard with no hold.

exit.$description: Elements leaving: starts slow and speeds up. Leave one duration step shorter than the element entered: a tooltip in over normal leaves over fast, a sheet in over slow leaves over normal. Going back to a screen is a screen change, not an exit.
